races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Snatch A Glance
runners_data.note: Excellent recent form on good ground with strong hold-up style perfectly suited to tracking the pace

runners_data.name: Current Edition
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could press the leader but limited recent form to assess

runners_data.name: Jimbo Sport
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner with good form including course win, will dictate the race tempo

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Prominent style but question marks over recent poor runs and lack of winning form

runners_data.name: Scarlet Moon
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid recent form who handles the ground conditions well

runners_data.name: King's Scholar
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer whose style depends entirely on a strong early gallop being set

runners_data.name: Josh Central
runners_data.note: Prominent style but significantly lower grade than these rivals based on official ratings

runners_data.name: Golden Garden
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid going record including recent course win at lower level

races.paceDynamic: Jimbo Sport will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating a controlled tempo that suits his style. Current Edition, Kenobi, Scarlet Moon and Josh Central will likely race prominently behind the leader, while Snatch A Glance, King's Scholar and Golden Garden are expected to be held up for late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jimbo Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Jimbo Sport gets soft fractions and sees out the trip strongly
scenarios.body: The leader controls the race unchallenged and kicks clear turning for home. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against solid pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Dual Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Current Edition and Scarlet Moon press Jimbo Sport from early stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates a battle between the prominent runners. King's Scholar emerges from the pack to capitalize on the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final furlong with Jimbo Sport weakening
scenarios.body: Snatch A Glance and King's Scholar benefit from their patient rides as the early pace fades. The class horses with hold-up styles dominate the finish despite giving ground away.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jimbo Sport sets very slow fractions and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a tactical affair decided by who quickens best. Golden Garden's recent win suggests improved form that could surprise at bigger odds.

watchPoints.text: Jimbo Sport getting uncontested lead could prove decisive given his front-running style and course form
King's Scholar and Snatch A Glance need strong early pace to be effective from their hold-up positions
Current Edition's fitness after limited recent runs could be exposed if forced to chase hard early
Josh Central and Golden Garden are significantly outclassed on ratings but both handle the ground
Kenobi's recent poor form suggests confidence issues that may not be easily resolved today

races.name: G.C.Rickards Mares' Handicap Chase (Queen Boudicca Mares' Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Annie Express
runners_data.note: Natural front runner but poor recent form suggests vulnerability when pressured by classier opposition.

runners_data.name: A Little Something
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong good going record but needs others to set genuine pace to be effective.

runners_data.name: Kit's Coty
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with best recent form and rating advantage suited to controlling race from forward position.

runners_data.name: Moonlightinthepark
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with limited good going experience but distance specialist who needs strong early tempo.

runners_data.name: Wishful Wings
runners_data.note: Confirmed hold-up runner who typically fades in finish but could benefit if pace completely collapses.

runners_data.name: Lynsey Larue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off good second place who can bridge gap between leaders and hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Annie Express and Kit's Coty will likely share early pace-setting duties from the front, with Lynsey Larue also positioned prominently early. This creates a genuine pace scenario where the three hold-up horses (A Little Something, Moonlightinthepark, Wishful Wings) must overcome positioning disadvantages. The sustained tempo should set up tactical battles in the final half-mile as the prominent runners either consolidate or crack under pressure from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Annie Express and Kit's Coty maintain sensible fractions without over-racing each other
scenarios.body: The pace becomes sustainable allowing the early leaders to kick clear approaching the final fence. Kit's Coty's superior rating and solid good going record proves decisive over Annie Express's recent inconsistency.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Annie Express and Kit's Coty engaging too eagerly
scenarios.body: A Little Something gets the perfect setup to unleash her finishing kick from the rear. Her proven good going form and tactical speed overwhelms tiring pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Lynsey Larue positions perfectly in third tracking the two leaders without committing early
scenarios.body: Her prominent style allows first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic problems facing the hold-up horses. Recent second place form suggests she can capitalize on ideal positioning despite her lower rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Annie Express leads unopposed with Kit's Coty and others sitting too far back
scenarios.body: The pace becomes crawling allowing even Wishful Wings to get competitive from her hold-up position. The race becomes a pure sprint finish where ratings matter less than who finds the best ground.

watchPoints.text: Annie Express could set uncontested lead if Kit's Coty drops back leaving no pace pressure early.
A Little Something needs others to go fast early or her hold-up style becomes ineffective from poor positioning.
Wishful Wings has established pattern of fading in finish so any early prominence would signal different tactics.
Kit's Coty versus Annie Express early positioning battle will determine if genuine pace materializes.
Moonlightinthepark making ground from rear in straight would indicate strong pace setup favoring closers.

races.name: Ben Chambers Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Oakley's Way
runners_data.note: Only confirmed pace-maker in the field, will dictate terms from the front

runners_data.name: D'Jo Dela Barriere
runners_data.note: Highest-rated hold-up horse with strong recent record on good ground

runners_data.name: Kates Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but poor recent form suggests vulnerability despite decent rating

runners_data.name: Jackomy
runners_data.note: Recent Ludlow winner who handles good ground well, key contender from off the pace

runners_data.name: Little Pi
runners_data.note: Lowest rated but in good recent form with soft ground preference less relevant today

runners_data.name: Triple Haych
runners_data.note: Warning flags for fading in the finish, likely to be found wanting when pace lifts

races.paceDynamic: Oakley's Way will take them along at a sustainable gallop with no obvious pace pressure in this small field. The five hold-up horses (D'Jo Dela Barriere, Kates Choice, Jackomy, Little Pi, Triple Haych) will need Oakley's Way to maintain a true pace to avoid a sprint finish that could expose the weaker finishers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way maintains an even gallop throughout allowing the race to develop naturally
scenarios.body: The higher-rated hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. D'Jo Dela Barriere and Jackomy benefit most from this patient tactical battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way goes too slowly early creating a bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the last hurdle heavily favoring the freshest finishers. Little Pi's recent winning form and Jackomy's class could prove decisive in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage as the closers struggle to make up ground. Oakley's Way proves too strong while the hold-up horses finish in his slipstream.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Exposes Faders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian and multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the straight
scenarios.body: Triple Haych's known finishing weakness becomes crucial as stronger stayers prevail. The race develops into a war of attrition favoring the most resolute battlers.

watchPoints.text: Triple Haych's known tendency to fade in the finish makes him vulnerable if the pace quickens from the last hurdle
Oakley's Way needs to judge the early fractions correctly as going too fast or too slow could compromise his chances
Little Pi carries bottom weight and recent winning form but faces a significant class rise against these opponents
The small field size could create tactical complications if Oakley's Way goes too slowly early
D'Jo Dela Barriere's hold-up style requires Oakley's Way to maintain honest gallop throughout

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Your Darling
runners_data.note: Class advantage but recent form patchy and needs to prove stamina over this extended trip

runners_data.name: Beachcomber
runners_data.note: Consistent recent efforts in similar company and handles good ground well from prominent position

runners_data.name: The Kalooki Kid
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up specialist whose style perfectly suits if others go too hard too early

runners_data.name: Destroytheevidence
runners_data.note: Strong recent win last time and dangerous if getting first run on rivals from forward position

runners_data.name: Annsam
runners_data.note: Inconsistent strike rate despite prominent racing style but has shown ability in this grade

runners_data.name: Lounge Lizard
runners_data.note: Recent winner with tactical speed who can adapt if pace develops differently than expected

races.paceDynamic: Your Darling will likely lead or share early duties with the predominantly prominent-racing field of Beachcomber, Destroytheevidence, Annsam, and Lounge Lizard all seeking forward positions. This creates a moderate pace that should suit The Kalooki Kid's hold-up style, allowing the patient ride to pick off tired leaders in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage early and maintain strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: Your Darling and Beachcomber press each other from the off, with Destroytheevidence and Annsam close up. The relentless tempo sets up The Kalooki Kid perfectly for his trademark late surge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Early Going
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners are more patient early, creating a steadier rhythm
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sedate with Your Darling allowed an easier lead while others bide their time. This favors the class horse Your Darling who can dictate terms and kick when ready.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If someone pushes the pace from halfway, disrupting the natural rhythm
scenarios.body: Annsam or Destroytheevidence forces the issue approaching the business end, stretching the field. Those with tactical speed like Lounge Lizard benefit from the honest gallop that develops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Jumping Drama
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the leading group significantly
scenarios.body: Early leaders get hampered by mistakes, creating gaps and changing the complexion entirely. The patient Kalooki Kid avoids trouble while others regroup, but chaos can throw up surprise results.

watchPoints.text: Your Darling must prove the 3-mile trip as previous efforts suggest stamina limitations
The Kalooki Kid needs sufficient pace up front to set up his finishing kick effectively
Destroytheevidence carries confidence from recent success and could dictate from prominent position
Multiple prominent runners may create scrimmaging for position in early stages
Lounge Lizard's versatility allows tactical adaptation if pace scenario changes mid-race

races.name: Parkinsons Awareness Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: High Fibre
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, recent form solid on good ground

runners_data.name: Jack Hyde
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent recent form, particularly strong on testing ground but handles good

runners_data.name: Roysse
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse who needs others to go fast early, underwhelming strike rate despite placing

runners_data.name: Crest Of Stars
runners_data.note: Natural front runner coming off a win, should get ideal tactical scenario as lone pace-setter

runners_data.name: D Day Arvalenreeva
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with strong record on good ground, three wins from recent form

runners_data.name: Filibustering
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who has been running well without winning, needs strong tempo to be competitive

races.paceDynamic: Crest Of Stars is the lone confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure from this field composition. With Jack Hyde and D Day Arvalenreeva likely to race prominently but not aggressively early, and three hold-up horses (High Fibre, Roysse, Filibustering) needing the pace to develop, Crest Of Stars should get an easy lead into the straight before the closers mount their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crest Of Stars Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Crest Of Stars gets uncontested early fractions and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The leader builds a soft advantage that proves hard to peg back when the hold-up horses make their moves. Jack Hyde and D Day Arvalenreeva track but can't sustain their challenges up the hill.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Hyde and D Day Arvalenreeva both race closer to the pace than usual
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo suits the hold-up trio who get the strong gallop they need to unleash finishing kicks. Crest Of Stars gets softened up by the faster pace and fades late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: One of the three closers produces a devastating late burst that catches the prominent racers napping. The lack of early pace becomes a tactical nightmare for those tracking the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupt the natural running order early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where natural running styles get compromised and form goes out the window. The most adaptable horse on the day capitalizes on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Crest Of Stars must be watched for jumping fluency as any mistake will hand initiative to prominent pair
Jack Hyde's positioning early will be crucial - if he races too keen it changes the entire complexion
High Fibre needs to be produced with perfectly timed run as he has no tactical speed if caught flat-footed
D Day Arvalenreeva's consistency on good ground makes him dangerous if others fail to capitalize on conditions
Filibustering requires strong tempo throughout - watch for signs of pace collapse favoring front runners

races.name: Bob Cashmore & Michael Davies Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Jet Plane
runners_data.note: Lone pace angle gives tactical advantage but recent form shows vulnerability when challenged

runners_data.name: Northern Bound
runners_data.note: Highest class rating and strong recent form but hold-up style may not suit shorter trip

runners_data.name: Fix At All
runners_data.note: Best placed to track and challenge the leader with solid recent form on good ground

runners_data.name: Great Valley
runners_data.note: Limited recent experience but prominent style suits, though class looks insufficient

runners_data.name: Missed Tee
runners_data.note: Hold-up style handicapped by likely lack of early pace and shorter distance

races.paceDynamic: Jet Plane is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a manageable gallop without pressure from similar types. The prominent runners Fix At All and Great Valley will track closely behind, while hold-up horses Northern Bound and Missed Tee will need the pace to collapse or tactical speed to be effective over this shorter trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jet Plane Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Plane gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The class horse controls from pillar to post with Fix At All and Great Valley unable to mount serious pressure. Northern Bound's finishing kick comes too late over the shorter distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Fix At All or Great Valley can pressure Jet Plane early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up the race for the prominent runners who can stay closer and kick. Jet Plane's stamina gets tested while the hold-up horses still lack tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Northern Bound's Class
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching or collapses completely
scenarios.body: Northern Bound's superior class rating and proven finishing kick becomes decisive as front runners tire. The former point-to-point winner shows his quality when the race develops to suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Plane goes too slow early then multiple horses challenge
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with several horses in contention turning in, favoring whoever has the best turn of foot. The race becomes a lottery with any of the five capable of winning.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Jet Plane gets a soft lead early - could prove unbeatable if allowed easy fractions
Monitor how quickly Northern Bound can get into contention given the shorter trip and likely steady pace
Observe Fix At All's jumping early - needs to stay close to capitalize on prominent position
Check Great Valley's fitness levels given limited recent racing compared to more experienced rivals
Watch for any early pace pressure between Fix At All and Great Valley that could set up back runners
